panels.description: Underwater, TJ's detached leg drags his head through old mine rails. The brass ring around his right eye is present but unaccented; leave upper area open.
The leg snaps back onto TJ's head underwater. Leave space above for the sound effect.
TJ's torso and remaining legs arrive separately and reassemble crookedly at the dock ladder. Preserve a dog silhouette.
TJ climbs onto the dock carrying a broken drone component. Leave upper third clear.
